## Ctx.handleArgsText() method

Route handler for text messages with args match intent `intentText`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
handleArgsText?(): Promise<unknown>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by text with space-separated args.

## Example


```typescript
// text = "start 123 aaa"
// validate "123" or "aaa" from mapping hash
async handleArgsText() {
   this.msg?.text // "start 123 aaa"
   this.msgTextArg // "123"
   this.msgTextArgs // ["123", "aaa"]
}
```
